composers_checked.name: Ligeti, György
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Gap check against Wikipedia's list: the two string quartets, the early Andante and Allegretto and the Horn Trio are the only chamber works for three to nine players with strings; Mysteries of the Macabre is an arrangement by Elgar Howarth; Aventures and Nouvelles aventures need ten players.

composers_checked.name: Kurtág, György
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Gap check against Wikipedia's opus table and MusicBrainz: all string quartets, the recorded trios and ensemble works for three to nine players. Troussova (Op. 17) and the Akhmatova songs (Op. 41) could not be confirmed as nine players or fewer.

composers_checked.name: Lutosławski, Witold
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. The String Quartet is his only recorded chamber work for three to nine players with strings; the nonet version of the Dance Preludes has no recording found.

composers_checked.name: Bacewicz, Grażyna
composers_checked.note: All seven string quartets, both piano quintets, the four-cello quartet and the oboe trio are recorded (Chandos complete quartets, Naxos, DG). Incrustations is not recorded.

composers_checked.name: Penderecki, Krzysztof
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Gap check against Wikipedia's list and Deezer: all four quartets, Der unterbrochene Gedanke, the String Trio, Clarinet Quartet, Sextet and Serenata are recorded; the eight-cello Agnus Dei is a transcription with no named arranger; no recording of a String Quintet was found.

composers_checked.name: Eötvös, Péter
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Only Korrespondenz and The Sirens Cycle (Calder Quartet, BMC Records) and Natasha (one track, Ensemble Linea) are recorded. Encore, Joyce, Molto tranquillo and Secret kiss have no recording found.

composers_checked.name: Veress, Sándor
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages (not in the violin catalogue). Two string quartets, the String Trio, Tre quadri and Introduzione e Coda are recorded (Toccata, Hungaroton, Alpha). The B-flat minor piano trio is kept at low confidence: its year and catalogue could not be found.

composers_checked.name: Seiber, Mátyás
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages in scope. The three string quartets and the Divertimento for clarinet and quartet are recorded; the Fantasia for flute, horn and quartet has no recording found.

composers_checked.name: Panufnik, Andrzej
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Three quartets, the reconstructed Piano Trio and the sextet version of Song to the Virgin Mary are recorded; the sextet's scoring (2 violins, 2 violas, 2 cellos) is assumed.

composers_checked.name: Haas, Pavel
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages (not in the violin catalogue). The three quartets, Fata morgana and Vyvolená are recorded.

composers_checked.name: Klein, Gideon
composers_checked.note: String Trio on IMSLP (a 1977 edition); the three quartets are on the Kocian Quartet's Praga disc. IMSLP's other works are duos or solos.

composers_checked.name: Krása, Hans
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages (not in the violin catalogue). The quartets and trios are on the Kocian Quartet's Praga disc; the scoring of Kammermusik comes from Boosey & Hawkes via a search snippet.

composers_checked.name: Ullmann, Viktor
composers_checked.note: String Quartet No. 3 (IMSLP says 5 minutes, but recordings run 12 to 14). The other chamber works are lost, unrecorded or too large.

composers_checked.name: Kaprálová, Vítězslava
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. The quartet is recorded (ArcoDiva); Leden is kept at low confidence because its year is unknown.

composers_checked.name: Hába, Alois
composers_checked.note: All sixteen string quartets are on the Hába Quartett's complete NEOS set, with Supraphon discs for Nos. 10-16; the four nonets are on Supraphon (Czech Nonet). The nonet scoring (flute, oboe, clarinet, bassoon, horn, violin, viola, cello, double bass) is assumed from the Czech Nonet.

composers_checked.name: Kilar, Wojciech
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. No chamber work for three to nine players with strings has a recording or published score found.

composers_checked.name: Meyer, Krzysztof
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages (not in the violin catalogue). Fifteen quartets and the other recorded chamber works are kept; opus numbers come from the Deezer track titles of the Pro Viva, Acte Préalable and DUX releases, years from de.wikipedia.

composers_checked.name: Ptaszyńska, Marta
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. The string quartet Four Portraits, Classical Variations and Dream Lands, Magic Spaces have premieres but no recording or score page found (Boosey & Hawkes sells a string quartet Mosaics, not checked).

note: EVIDENCE: work lists from the English and German Wikipedia composer and work lists, Universal Edition (Kurtag Op. 11), IRCAM/EMB and Boosey & Hawkes via web-search snippets, and PWM via a search snippet; recordings from Deezer track and album pages (labels, release years and timings; album ids in sources) and MusicBrainz for Ligeti and Kurtag. Durations are taken from the recordings (IMSLP's 5 minutes for Ullmann's Third Quartet is wrong: 12 to 14). VIOLIN CATALOGUE: none of the nine violin entries is cross-listed: 468 (Haba), 485 (Kurtag), 489 (Ligeti), 521 and 4263 are duos for two violins, 4258 is four violins, 520 is a two-violin concerto grosso with chamber orchestra, 4594 (Kilar, Oda Bela Bartok in memoriam) is for violin, brass, percussion, two harps and piano (PWM), 4752 (Penderecki, Duo concertante) is a duo. OWNER MAY RULE: (1) voice-with-ensemble works kept under the vocal rule: Kurtag Scenes from a Novel, ...pas a pas..., Four Songs Op. 11; Eotvos The Sirens Cycle; Haas Vyvolena; Haba Op. 101 melodrama; Kapralova Leden; (2) Haba's four nonets: the scoring (flute, oboe, clarinet, bassoon, horn, violin, viola, cello, double bass) is assumed from the Czech Nonet, which recorded them; (3) low-confidence entries: Veress Piano Trio in B-flat minor (no year found), Meyer Trio Op. 90 (cello or violin) and Clarinet Quintet Op. 66 (only Wikipedia's discography), Kapralova Leden; (4) Panufnik's Song to the Virgin Mary for string sextet (scoring assumed 2 violins, 2 violas, 2 cellos); (5) Kurtag's cimbalom parts are entered as percussion; Krasa's Kammermusik follows the Boosey scoring (four clarinets doubling E-flat clarinet, bass clarinet and alto saxophone, trumpet, cello, double bass, harpsichord; ed. Karas); (6) Kurtag Brefs messages, Hommage a Jacob Obrecht and Ligatura rest on one or two sources. NOT KEPT: Kurtag's Troussova (Op. 17: soprano with about ten instrumentalists) and Four Capriccios (chamber orchestra); Akhmatova Songs Op. 41 (player count not confirmed); Eotvos's later quartet and mixed works (no recording found); Haas Fata morgana (scoring of the one recording unconfirmed); the nonet version of Lutoslawski's Dance Preludes, Panufnik's Train of Thoughts and Triangles, Seiber's Fantasia for flute, horn and quartet, Veress's Baryton-Trio, Krasa's Rimbaud songs, Ullmann's Second Quartet (no recording found); Ptaszynska's Four Portraits, Classical Variations and Dream Lands (premieres only) and Kilar's Training 68 (nothing found). Penderecki's eight-cello Agnus Dei and Seiber's Introduction and Allegro are arrangements without a named arranger. NOT CHECKED (budget): publisher catalogues of Boosey, Chester, Schott, PWM and Sikorski were not opened, so unrecorded published works may be missing.
